lines.text: Many learners say: There are much people here.
Better: There are many people here.
Many! How many books do you have?

native.tip: مع المعدود نستخدم many: “There are many people here.” وليس “There are much people here.”.
native.caption: هل تقول أحيانًا “There are much people here.” 😅 مع المعدود نستخدم many، فالجملة الصحيحة “There are many people here.” استمع إلى Ama وكرّر! تدرّب أكثر في تطبيق Lexkite.

en.hook: Do you say “There are much people here”?
en.tip: With countable things we use many: “There are many people here.” not “There are much people here.”.
en.caption: Do you sometimes say “There are much people here.” 😅 With countable things we use many, so the right sentence is “There are many people here.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
